name: triple_gate.py
mathematical_scope: For fixed F8 shuffle, builds 10x9 block matrix [A,-B,0; A,0,-C] for projected three-column spaces; rank9 excludes a nonzero shared direction, while rank deficiency is necessary only. Also provides coordinate/kernel and fourth-column diagnostics on the regular tail chart.
input_and_guard_coverage: Field primality, primitive root, rectangular shapes, nonempty matrices, canonical residues and U/L lengths are caller assumptions. build_UL excludes raw h0,t==0 but not residues equal to zero mod p. Enumeration skips h0=0, Delta=0,t=0. Higher nullity is explicitly set aside in extension diagnostic.
costs: Enumeration over p^4 tuples, constant-size field matrix elimination per surviving tuple, so O(p^4) iterations for fixed N=8. Generic rank/nullspace O(m*n*min(m,n)) field operations with inversion costs.
test_evidence: No direct tests of triple_gate diagnostic labels in the new suite; universal gate tests consume its rank/build_UL helpers. Archived universal-gate counts/witnesses are distinct from this early diagnostic.
acceptance_boundary: Necessary exclusion remains valid. rank(G)<9 is not sufficient for a nonzero common image, and coordinate visibility is not a factorization certificate. No archived accepted witness is invalidated by this observation.
findings: L87–89 labels kernel nontriviality as nontrivial_intersection without checking A*x!=0. Exact abstract example A=[e1,e1,0], B=[e2,e2,0], C=[e3,e3,0] in F^5 has rank(G)=3<9 but zero triple image intersection.

The same example has kernel basis with coordinate visibility at 0,3,6, so L130 still reports good despite only zero shared images. Over GF17 the union-of-three-hyperplanes argument does ensure some vector has all three coordinates nonzero, but that still does not ensure a nonzero image.

L169–170 correctly marks higher-nullity cases unresolved. The stored README/RESEARCH says 1330 admitted universal candidates are still possibly invalid; no specific archived witness/conclusion was found relying on the incorrect sufficient interpretation.
